acceptance: Four standard-library Fraction/integer entries, active exceptions under -O, outward transcendental bounds, pinned byte manifest and deterministic report replay.
limitations: No complete general optimizer, new unknown sharp value, exact gamma, crystallization, uniqueness or global priority claim.
Microscopic covering is for fixed interior disks; the separate whole-background estimate is of coarser order.
The W1 narrow asymptotic constant retains external inputs and has no claimed effective starting threshold.
New geometric criteria are necessary conditions, not full-domain classifications.
AI independent checks are not external peer review or whole-proof formal verification.
